From Claude Fable:

Thanks. Done in 33dd68ee43: the benchmark now has two candidates, the model's unfused path (projection kernel + `sp_reduce_scatter` / `tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce`, backend chosen by vLLM's dispatch, so FlashInfer all-reduce for AR and the custom Lamport reduce-scatter for small RS messages) and the fused kernel. The NCCL RING_LL/LDMC candidates, bare GEMM/collective candidates, their symmetric-memory scratch and the pandas dependency are gone; output is one table with the latency change plus optional `--json`.

Re-measured on 4xB200 TP4 with the new baseline (tables in the description): the crossover moves to about 1024 tokens for RS (vLLM's Lamport reduce-scatter beats the fused kernel at 128-512 tokens), and to about 2048 for AR against FlashInfer all-reduce. Kimi-K3 BF16 shows the same shape (RS: +12% at M=128, -36% at M=8192; AR: +31% at 128, -25% at 8192, K=1536). The `should_run` cutoff of 128 may deserve a second look on your side too.
